description: Survey a whole area of technology: the frontier's fields (with a one-line explainer each) and their programs sorted by importance, with stage and next milestone. Without `frontier` it lists every frontier with its slug. Use `field` to narrow to one field (slugs come back in the result).

field.description: Optional field slug within the frontier, e.g. 'geothermal'

frontier.description: Frontier slug, e.g. 'energy', 'robotics', 'space', 'ai'. Omit to list all frontiers.

perField.description: Programs per field (default 4, max 10; default 15, max 25 when a field is given)

name: get_frontier
title: Survey a frontier
